url.title: Instagram post URL or shortcode
url.description: Full Instagram post URL or shortcode. Include the username to enable an exact-match fallback through the account’s recent posts, for example https://www.instagram.com/instagram/p/Dc30nJeRKKz/.

shortcode.title: Instagram post shortcode
shortcode.description: Instagram post shortcode. Use this when you do not have the full post URL. Example shortcode: DUBtwxGEqz2.

media_id.title: Instagram media id / shortcode
media_id.description: Deprecated legacy input name. Use the URL or shortcode field above for new integrations. This actor treats media_id as the Instagram post shortcode.
